nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Truth Serum Hydrating Vitamin C Serum

segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including combination, acne-prone) skin report the serum absorbs well, controls shine, and provides a balanced glow without heaviness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin frequently report the serum does not irritate despite its strong citrus fragrance, and some say it calms redness while brightening.
segments.oily: One reviewer notes the serum absorbs quickly even on oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it feels moisturizing and well suited to dull, dry skin, leaving it feeling less dry and more hydrated.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly describe the serum as hydrating and plumping without feeling oily, often noting soft, glowy, moisturized skin after use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report the serum reduces redness and irritation compared to other vitamin C products they have tried, describing it as gentle even with a noticeable citrus fragrance.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and sun spots with consistent use, often within a few weeks.
concerns.blemishes: A few early reviewers report the serum caused breakouts or small bumps, while many later reviewers, including some with acne-prone or combination skin, say it did not cause breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the serum as absorbing well without oiliness, including on oily skin, and note it helps control shine on combination skin.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky feel right after application
Can cause pilling under makeup or sunscreen
Pump lacks a protective cap for the light-sensitive formula

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin just did not like this product. I broke out immediately after using it. I'm sure it would be great for someone with a different skin type but it did not work out for me. I do love the bottle and how it twists to lock the pump. There also doesn't seem like much product in the bottle.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am in my 30s and have acne-prone, combination skin. I love vitamin c products for brightening my dark spots, as I definitely get acne scar/post acne hyperpigmentation, so I was excited to try out this serum. The serum is a gel-serum consistency and I appreciate that it is in a convenient pump bottle. The serum smells nicely like oranges, it spreads easily on my skin and absorbs nicely, while leaving my skin hydrated, but is not heavy, oily, or greasy. It works well under my usual products and makeup. It also doesn't irritate my skin nor cause any breakouts which I appreciate. From the limited time I used it, I feel my skin does look slightly smoother and slightly brighter— but doesn't seem to do much on my acne scars. I've got other vitamin C products that are more effective at fading my acne scars, but I would say this is a nice gentle vitamin c product, with an elegant formula for those who have sensitive skin. Overall, I'll happily use up my bottle, but I think I'll go with my Japanese vitamin C product that works more effectively for my scars in the future.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Pretty thick texture, that surprisingly glides very well onto skin, and gets absorbed momentarily even by oily skin. The pump is very convenient, and one pump is enough for my entire face. The glass bottle gives luxury, seems very durable, and has a decent amount of product in it. The product itself has an amazing citrus scent, that doesn't linger long on skin. This serum makes my skin feel soft and supple to the touch, and gives inner radiance instantly. I also noticed soft improvement in irritation and redness, which made this serum very suitable for my skin concerns.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great addition to my morning skincare routine!! As a sensitive skin girlie, I love the formulation of this serum so much! The vitamin C concentration is just strong enough to have an effect and still low enough to not irritate my skin. Usually, vitamin C toners/serums/creams tend to leave me pretty red and irritated. I've been using this serum for a few weeks now and my face is brighter & very hydrated! Most importantly, zero irritation. Score!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This stuff is amazing! I have been using it around 2 weeks and have already noticed a difference in the overall brightness of my skin & dark spots. It blends well with my makeup and doesn't cause any piling. It's also super moisturizing for my dry skin, but doesn't make me feel oily. It soaks right in and doesn't leave any sort of residue, and is a super light serum !!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The nice thing about this product is that it contains aloe Vera, which is a great calming ingredient for the skin. It has a citrusy scent and is fairly light weight, absorbed well into my skin and left a really nice yet subtle glow. The reasoning for my lower rating is I'm not too sure if my skin really took to this product or not. Unfortunately in the next couple days after using the product for sometime, I developed little dots on my skin. I'm not sure if it was caused by this serum or just some off chance skin event, but I could have been a tad bit too strong of vitamin c for me unfortunately!
